firstCoverPrompt:
Create ONE finished premium Xiaohongshu marketing poster, portrait 3:4, 1536x2048, Chinese typography. This is card 01 of a coherent six-card campaign selling bespoke personal résumé/portfolio WEBSITES by 一页映. Audience is ordinary people considering their own website, not lighting professionals. Deliver a single poster, not a collage of six options.

INPUTS: image 1 is an actual desktop website screenshot, image 2 is the actual mobile version. Treat these as fixed product-screen inserts: preserve their design, Chinese content, character imagery, proportions and recognizable browser UI. Do not invent a new webpage or new character art. The website and client artwork are the product proof; game art is NOT created by the website service.

ART DIRECTION: luxurious editorial digital-design advertisement. Midnight ink navy (#0b1021), soft cool periwinkle (#b8b4ff), tiny champagne accents (#dfc696), ivory headlines. Very restrained smooth light across the background, clean surfaces, no grain/noise, no neon orbs, no decorative squiggles, no dense cards, no outer rounded border. A confident generous asymmetric composition, readable at phone size. Type occupies top 28%, large screen composition dominates lower 60%. Small purposeful margins, 7% safe zone. Thin precise window chrome, almost front-facing desktop screenshot at full useful scale, phone screenshot as a smaller companion at lower-right without obscuring the desktop title or character face; minimal realistic depth and gentle shadows, no branded hardware, no keyboard.

EXACT TEXT, only these poster-level text strings:
top small but legible: “一页映 · 网页作品集定制”
large main title in TWO lines: “作品集做成网页” / “第一眼就不一样”
short subtitle: “真实客户案例｜电脑与手机，都认真设计”
lower footer: “网页设计与制作：一页映”
small footer note: “案例已授权 · 信息已脱敏”
tiny pagination in bottom-right: “01 / 06”
Make the title very large, 95–115px equivalent at 1242px width, crisp Chinese sans-serif, no faux handwritten type. Body copy at least 38px equivalent at 1242px width. Do not add callouts or technical jargon or English headings. Do not add QR codes, prices, testimonials, results claims or platform logos. Keep all Chinese text exact. This poster must immediately read as a beautiful WEBSITE design case, not a videogame poster.
